title: Te Moe i Tua atu i te Wā
intro: Whakaarohia te wā i huna ai te pono, ā, i whaia ai ngā whakapono. I whiriwhiria e tētahi rōpū iti te hoki whakamuri i te tuku i a rātou anō, ka kitea he piringa i ngā wāhi tino kore e taea te whakaaro — he wāhi ka noho hei wāhi okiokinga mō rātou mō ngā rautau e kore e taea te tatau. I tō rātou oho ake, kua huri te ao huri noa i a rātou. Ko wai ēnei wairua e moe ana?
clues: He taitamariki mātou e noho ana i tētahi tāone tawhito.
I tono tō mātou hapori kia karakia tahi mātou me rātou, engari i whakakahore mātou.
I oma atu mātou i te tāone ki te rapu piringa i te hunga i whakahē i ō mātou whakapono.
I noho tetahi hoa waewae-whā pono ki te tomokanga o tō mātou piringa.
Nā Atua tātou i mea kia moe mō ngā tau e toru rau e iwa.
I tō mātou oho ake, kua awhi tō mātou tāone i whakatoi i mua i te whakapono.

identity.label: Ko wai tātou?
options: Āshab al-Kahf (Te Iwi o te Ana)
Ashab al-Fil (Te Ope Taua a te Elephant)
Ngā Hoa o te Parekura (Ashab al-Ukhdud)
Te Hawariyyun (Nga akonga a Isa)
Yajuj wa Majuj (Koko raua ko Makoka)
identity.answer: Āshab al-Kahf (Te Iwi o te Ana)

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I hoki mātou ki roto i tētahi ana, ā, i moe mō ngā rautau
I whakaorangia mātou i te mura o te ahi
I horomia mātou e te ika nui
I whakamatautauria mātou ki tētahi kamera uha whakamiharo
I homai ki a mātou e iwa ngā tohu mārama
trial.answer: I hoki mātou ki roto i tētahi ana, ā, i moe mō ngā rautau

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He ana hohonu i roto i ngā maunga
He poti i te moana tuwhera
He whare teitei e anga atu ana ki te rangi
He māra i wehea i waenganui i ngā hoa whakataetae e rua
He ārai rino me te parahi
location.answer: He ana hohonu i roto i ngā maunga

outcome.label: Hua
options: I ara ake mātou, ā, kua tahuri tō mātou tāone ki te whakapono
I mātao, i rangimārie te ahi mura
I toremi te ope taua a te hoariri ki te moana
Nā ngā manu e kawe ana i ngā kōhatu i whakangaro te hoariri
I tukuna mātou e tētahi ika nui ki uta
outcome.answer: I ara ake mātou, ā, kua tahuri tō mātou tāone ki te whakapono

arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
